posts.text: When we fight back in the courts, congress, and across the country, we can stop the Trump agenda. So glad to hear Trump’s $1.8 billion dollar slush fund is not moving forward.

I've teamed up with @RepDerekTranCA to demand answers from GKN Aerospace following the incident at their Garden Grove facility.

This was a serious failure that must never happen again in California or anywhere across the country.

Video

It's Election Day, California!

We can build a better country if we make our voices heard.

Visit sos.ca.gov/elections/polling… to find your nearest polling location, and get out and vote! 🗳️

It is outrageous that Donald Trump negotiated a $1.8 billion fund with himself, so that election deniers and January 6ers could benefit.

Fortunately, the courts are pushing back.

Video

Pam Bondi deflected responsibility for the Epstein files over 30 times while a top DOJ lawyer stopped her from answering any questions about the President. 

Republicans need to release the transcript now.

Video

This White House is the most corrupt Administration in history.

But our work on Epstein and recent court wins like those on the Kennedy Center and Trump’s $1.8 billion slush fun prove that when we fight, we can win and slow the Trump agenda.

Video

We asked Pam Bondi about Ghislaine Maxwell's prison transfer. She claimed not to know about it and instead placed blame on Acting AG Todd Blanche and the Bureau of Prisons.

We have a lot more questions, especially for Mr. Blanche, and Republicans should join us in asking them.

Video

Ms. Bondi, you said “Blanche was managing the entire investigation” and you said he was responsible for redactions that exposed survivors. You deflected to him over 30 times.

We think Chairman Comer should have videotaped this, don’t you agree?

I asked the Former AG multiple times about her conversations with President Trump: what he knew, what he told her to do, and she refused to answer ANY questions about the President.

She refused over and over again to answer any questions about Trump. Why?
